jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Avocado production manual (Hass focus)
kalro_guide_ref: KALRO Avocado production guide + HCD export standards

varieties.name: Hass
varieties.supplier_notes: Export gold standard; 80% of Kenyan avocado exports. First fruit at 2-3 years; full yield at 5-7.

varieties.name: Fuerte
varieties.supplier_notes: Local market preferred; thinner skin; ships less well.

timeline_template.description_en: Mark planting holes 8m x 8m. Dig 60cm cubed holes. Mix topsoil + 2 tins manure per hole.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka alama mashimo 8m x 8m. Chimba mashimo 60cm pande zote. Changanya udongo na samadi.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant grafted seedling at original nursery depth. Stake against wind.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mche uliotokana na kupandikiza, kina sawa na kitalu. Simika nguzo.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100g DAP per hole, mixed into soil before planting.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 100 za DAP kwa shimo.

timeline_template.description_en: Water 20L per tree weekly for first 12 weeks if no rain.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwagilia lita 20 kwa mti kwa wiki kwa wiki 12 ikiwa hakuna mvua.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed basin around tree. Mulch heavily.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kuzunguka mti. Funika na nyasi.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 250g NPK 17:17:17 per tree. Split into 2 doses 6 months apart.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 250 za NPK kwa mti. Gawanya dosi 2.

timeline_template.description_en: Light pruning to shape — remove suckers and crossing branches.
Scout for false codling moth + thrips. Spray only at threshold.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tafuta vidudu vya parachichi. Nyunyuza wakizidi.

timeline_template.description_en: First commercial fruits at year 2-3. Pick when fruit is firm and dark.
timeline_template.description_sw: Matunda ya kwanza ya kuuza mwaka 2-3. Vuna yakiwa magumu.
timeline_template.tip_en: Hass: skin turns dark before pick. Fuerte: skin stays green; test by feel.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Hass: ngozi inakuwa nyeusi. Fuerte: ngozi inabaki kijani.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Export A: 200-350g, no blemishes, oil content 23%+. Grade B: 150-200g or minor scars.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cold chain 4-7°C from pack-house to destination. Don't freeze.
